primaryChinese.quote: 後與劉建峰據湖南，推建峰為帥。）〉
唐乾寧初，劉建峰據湖南，獨邵州不賓，命都將馬殷討之，期歲未克，而建峰為部下所殺，軍亂，鄰寇且至。

s0186.literal: Later with Liu Jianfeng he seized Hunan and pushed Jianfeng as commander.)〉
s0186.idiomatic: He later seized Hunan with Liu Jianfeng and made Jianfeng commander.)〉

s0187.literal: At the start of Tang Qianning, Liu Jianfeng held Hunan; only Shaozhou would not submit; he ordered capital commander Ma Yin to attack it—a year passed without taking it, and Jianfeng was killed by subordinates, the army in disorder, neighboring enemies about to arrive.
s0187.idiomatic: Early in Qianning Liu Jianfeng held Hunan while Shaozhou held out; Ma Yin besieged it a year without success, then Jianfeng was murdered, the army mutinied, and enemies closed in.
